g.text: Leftover download folders 5 size not readable
cache — removed by nog; root is needed
orphans — pacman -Rns: pacman shows the list and asks first
aur — removed by nog; your own files, so no password
flatpak — flatpak uninstall --unused: flatpak works out the exact list, shows it and r
moves it (your pick here is the yes)
snap — snap remove --revision, one by one; root is needed
